title: Site origin comparison at fixed evaluation packages
statement: Let O be a commutative ring, ell in O, with every quotient O/(ell^(n+1)) finite. Let T be any scheme and PE a fixed derived evaluation package on strict etale coefficient systems [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. There exists an actual derived etale/pro-etale site comparison C at PE [def-pur-exceptional-system-transport-interfaces]. Its inverse and direct functors preserve every cohomological lower bound. Its unit is invertible on bounded-below systems, its counit on bounded-below pro-etale systems with etale-origin levels; the inverse sends bounded-below etale systems to this origin class. Both directions preserve normalized systems on that class. Evaluation at every n sends this system origin to finite level origin. At each finite level the actual unit is invertible on bounded-below objects, the actual counit is invertible on finite origin objects, and inverse image sends bounded-below objects to finite origin. All objects and maps are those of the full comparison package, and level n denotes exponent n+1.

proof.text: Apply the core construction theorem to obtain the comparison object, its equivalence, and the unit, counit, and inverse-origin assertions.
For an origin witness, transport its lower-bound witness through the finite inverse comparison and the evaluation isomorphism, using exact evaluation and the finite inverse lower-bound lemma.

proof_origin.place: Separated construction, finite level lower-bound, and evaluation-origin projection steps

lean.statement: theorem exceptionalSiteOriginComparison (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (ell : O) [∀ n : ℕ, Finite (O ⧸ (Ideal.span ({ell} : Set O)) ^ (n + 1))] (T : Scheme.{u}) (PE : StrictEtaleEvaluation T O ell) : ∃ C : ExceptionalSystemSiteComparison O ell T PE, ExceptionalSystemSiteEquivalence C ∧ (∀ n M, C.origin M → C.levelOrigin n ((C.proEvaluation.evaluation n).obj M)) ∧ (∀ n M, (∃ a : ℤ, M.IsGE a) → IsIso ((C.image.level n).adjunction.unit.app M)) ∧ (∀ n M, C.levelOrigin n M → IsIso ((C.image.level n).adjunction.counit.app M)) ∧ (∀ n M, (∃ a : ℤ, M.IsGE a) → C.levelOrigin n ((C.image.level n).inverse.obj M))
